In the main Llama-3-Instruct (8B) setting, **SimPO gets a 33.8% Arena-Hard win rate and DPO gets 32.6%**, so SimPO leads by 1.2 points (Table 4, p. 6).

**Confidence intervals.** The 95% intervals overlap, so this gap is small (Table 10, p. 20):
- SimPO: 33.8, with an interval of 32.0–35.9
- DPO: 32.6, with an interval of 30.3–34.8

**v0.2 setting.** The appendix also reports an updated version that uses a stronger reward model (ArmoRM) to label the preference data (Table 12, p. 29):
- SimPO v0.2: 36.5%
- DPO: 35.2%
- IPO: 36.6%, which is the highest in that table

The authors note that with a strong SFT model and higher-quality preference data, the differences between algorithms become less pronounced. They say DPO, IPO and R-DPO reach similar raw win rates on Arena-Hard (p. 30).
